# Scope

This travel policy applies to all employees of Contoso who travel for business. It covers flights, rail, hotels and meals.

# Booking

Flights must be booked at least 14 days in advance through the corporate travel portal. Bookings made later need written approval from a director.

## Travel class

Economy class is required for flights shorter than 6 hours. Premium economy is allowed for longer flights.

# Meals

The daily meal allowance is 45 euros. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

# Hotels

Hotel rooms may cost up to 160 euros per night in capital cities and 120 euros elsewhere.
